greylock._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md §8). Greylock's rows arrive from six renderings of one book: the 1999-2001 frameset tables, the 2001-2003 ASP listing, the 2005-2010 ColdFusion cards, the 2011-2015 Rails logo grid, the 2018-2023 WordPress logo wall and the 2026 Sanity site, plus SEC issuers filing under a registered name no listing used. Most filename variants are fixed upstream in sources/wayback/parsed by scratch/fix-parsed-names.py, which is where the First Round rule puts them; what remains here are the pairs that rule cannot see -- an abbreviation with no unique canonical prefix, and a registered name that differs from the listed one. Canonical = the name the firm's own listings use.
